title: Agent Slayer first-class object binding
description: The canonical compact runtime binding from one user-language mention to one or more verified objects of the same domain-qualified type and owning source. Object Description metadata produces these bindings and object-input binding metadata consumes their exact IDs or stable references.

mention.description: Compact user-facing language connected to this verified object set.

type.description: Domain-qualified object type declared by the owning Object Description.

source.description: Owning provider or native domain, not merely the tool that happened to return the object.

objects.description: One bulk-shaped set even when exactly one object is bound.

sourceEventSeqs.description: Ledger event numbers proving where this exact binding was observed.

ref.description: Stable domain-owned reference for this exact object.

display.description: Human-facing name or compact label for the same object.
